notes: «وَ سَأَلَهُ» names no asker, only the pronoun; the asker is not written. The one asked is the Imam that prev2 names (prev1 writes no speaker), so Musa ibn Jafar is inherited from prev2 as the single, last link.
The asker and the answer are read as they stand; prev2 is the nearest report that names its speaker.
